product_brief: A toolkit for measuring the performance of cryptographic software, including hash functions, ciphers, and public-key systems.
pqc_capability_description: SUPERCOP measures the performance of public-key encryption systems (including KEMs) and public-key signature systems. It is a benchmarking toolkit that evaluates cryptographic primitives, including those relevant to post-quantum cryptography, by measuring time and size metrics on various architectures.
crypto_primitives: hash functions, secret-key stream ciphers, authenticated ciphers, public-key encryption systems, KEMs, public-key signature systems, public-key secret-sharing systems
primary_platforms: Linux, ARM Cortex-A8, Intel Sandy Bridge, Intel Haswell
implementation_attack_surface: Mentions side-channel attacks using RDPMC; notes that variable-time software targeted by such attacks may not be secure against competent attackers with RDTSC or other clocks.
testing_&_validation_methods: Performance benchmarking (time, size), independent verification of speed measurements, median and quartile reporting, stabilized quartiles.
constrained_device_&_iot_suitability: Mentions ARM Cortex-A8 and ARM big.LITTLE systems; discusses heterogeneous cores and underclocking/overclocking considerations for performance measurement.
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: Includes code from questionable sources such as NSA; open to public contributions.

product_brief: An open source C library for quantum-resistant cryptographic algorithms developed by the Open Quantum Safe project.
pqc_capability_description: liboqs is an open source C library for quantum-resistant cryptographic algorithms. It includes implementations of SLH-DSA, NTRU, ML-KEM, Classic McEliece, LMS, and OV-III. It supports hybrid key authentication and exchange for TLS 1.3, X.509, and CMS via integrations like oqs-provider, OQS-BoringSSL, and OQS-OpenSSH. It provides wrappers for C++, Go, Java, Python 3, and Rust.
crypto_primitives: SLH-DSA, NTRU, ML-KEM, Classic McEliece, LMS, OV-III, SPHINCS+ (deprecated), Dilithium (removed)
primary_platforms: C, C++, Go, Java, Python 3, Rust; integrations for OpenSSL 3, BoringSSL, OpenSSH; demos for Apache, Chromium, curl, haproxy, nginx, Wireshark
pqc_roadmap_details: liboqs 0.15.0 is the last version to officially support SPHINCS+. SPHINCS+ will be removed in the 0.16.0 release and replaced by SLH-DSA. liboqs 0.15.0 also removes support for Dilithium.
testing_&_validation_methods: ACVP tests (SLH-DSA ACVP tests, Re-enabled all ACVP tests), constant-time testing, weekly tests, continuous benchmarking, code scanning workflow
